method: Project pages, released JAR metadata, archive inventories, and bytecode/API inspection. Runtime evidence and its limits are recorded separately in docs/evidence/integrations.

artifacts.caveat: CurseForge project lists MIT, but the downloaded JAR metadata says All Rights Reserved. No code or assets copied.

inventory_findings.caveat: Page advertises motorized bearings/spin drives; no such implementation identified in this release. Absence of names alone is not proof about other versions.

integration_findings: Release notes and registered style IDs include arrow_4d and arrow_4d_dbl_spine despite stale main-page future list.
TrackComponents provides centerBeam, tie, leftRail and rightRail; left/right Arrow 4D models each combine main and static control-rail geometry.
No profile-driven control-rail API established by this inspection.
Project page MIT and embedded All Rights Reserved metadata still differ; no third-party implementation or assets copied into this repository.
artifacts.validation: Metadata, model inventory and class inspection only; not runtime certification.

inventory_findings.seat_accounting: StationHandler.countSeats scans CoasterSeatRegistry; independent 4D carrier seats need explicit accounting.
inventory_findings.dispatch: StationBlockEntity.setOccupied schedules link-output release; no direct 4D operation call. Must coordinate with validated 4D station requests and propulsion guards.
inventory_findings.scope: Development adapter for station telemetry/dispatch and fin interlocks. Native acceptance evidence is maintained separately; rotating-seat replacement and complete addon certification remain open.

integration_findings: Acceleration is injected at the head of native CoasterCartChainLiftDrive.applySpeedMatch and changes chassis velocity. An optional whole-method wrapper guards all injected propulsion before it can run.
Powered anchor modes accelerate in the existing direction of travel and brake toward zero; initial speed below 0.001 does not launch.
Native client replacements target the base Coasters track renderer. Fourth Dimension retains its own rails, ties, controls and seat magnets; native Magnetized rail models are not imported.
Exact-version native fixture evidence is recorded separately; client equipment visuals and full lifecycle certification remain pending.

source_references.version_note: Inspected development source; confirm APIs against the chosen released dependency.
